delta.note: PP 20/2026 amends PP 55/2022 regarding final income tax (0.5%) on business income of taxpayers with certain gross turnover (UMKM), exclusions for independent personal services, cooperatives and sole-proprietor companies, and the non-deductibility of bribes as business expenses. It does not change any PPh 21 rate, threshold, deduction, or calculation step for permanent employees; it concerns other taxpayers (business owners) and other taxes.
